objective: Implement BUKLOD Kingdom free permanent gameplay powers and safe earn/spend Shards in Main app using existing server-verified Mastery and Character badges, while continuing unlimited-cost-free offline procedural levels without paid AI or Vercel. Add native Hall/Treasury inventory and interstitial opportunities after verified item claims and Shard unlocks; opt-in practice hint is separately gated.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main source baseline 5efb99435243a4bcaeff27fc8d41d58b6a9969c2. Former Kingdom PR #643 exact compiled head bd7f7854f7bb5f9122517c1b9538283b9315ecfc. Live Supabase read-only inspection confirms existing private kingdom_xp/game_xp wallet, credited Mastery attempt and official 2 BP source-key ledger, public claimed character collectible state. No existing Shards ledger or active dev DB branches found. SQL changes are staged as a migration file only; no live production DDL executed. Physical device/visual verification waived by owner.
chosenApproach: Use existing main Supabase as game-only authority; stage isolated private RLS Shards wallet/ledger and fixed-price purchases, RPC granted to authenticated users only. Source grants exclusively from credited server-scored game Mastery plus redeemed Character collectibles, retroactively idempotent. Implement Main Treasury and verified offline entitlement cache for noncredit practice Lens/Shield/Compass/Aura. Extend each existing 39-game procedural route to 5,000 levels with 32 varied patterns. No paid AI, new project, client-issued points or game cash. Put passive Android ads on non-gameplay Hall/Treasury views, use server-verified idempotent claim receipts for completion-only full-screen ads, and preserve protected game routes. Add Android opt-in rewarded video with SDK earned proof for one temporary local-only hint; web safely returns no reward and cannot import native SDK.
selectionRationale: No additional provider needed; existing Mastery/collectible records already have server-owned source keys and first-achievement constraints. Permanent power purchases avoid offline consumable double-spend. A gated SQL migration plus React Native UI allows preview and compiled QA without silently modifying the already-live production backend. Existing verified BP/rank wallet unchanged.

Client-side Shard balance and unlocks (rejected: trivial tampering, duplication and cross-account inconsistencies)
Reuse existing verified server proofs plus atomic permanent Shards purchases and free deterministic levels (chosen)
